data_exposure: All records are historical and previously available to this research lane. The protocol is frozen before this run, not before original outcomes or prior research.

retained_source_holds.reason: Absent in inherited frozen archive; no substitution.

aggregation: Nonnegative finite measurements averaged within (end-cadence,end]; no future-target filling. Preserve empty buckets as NaN.

grid.clock: EIA source local calendar-day label; final revised values, no publication-time guarantee

geothermal.clock: Source clock unspecified timezone; no cross-source alignment

method_rules.seasonal: Value at issue+horizon-seasonal_steps, only when observed and already available; no fallback.

scenario_rules.application: Only observations at/after evaluation boundary; ground truth never mutated. Freshness expires after 3 cadence steps. Simulated delays apply at all issue times including pre-boundary warmup.
scenario_rules.outage: All evaluation observations missing; warmup ages out.

slice_rules: High threshold=calibration observed-value q90; ramp threshold=calibration adjacent-bucket absolute change q90. Slice labels use clean issue-time truth for offline audit only and are not supplied to models.
comparison: Every candidate versus both persistence and seasonal on identical finite target/baseline/candidate rows; also report all eligible and available counts. Never pool native errors across units.

decision_rules.status: Descriptive prioritization only. No p-values, significance, external validation, financial conversion, or deployment approval.

failure_rules: All planned sources/scenarios/horizons/methods/slices required in manifest
scope: Three energy-related operational domains, seventeen measured series, multiple native units. Other sectors are transfer hypotheses only.
freeze_note: Git commit and protocol SHA provide a reviewable local freeze; neither is an independently witnessed pre-outcome seal.

serialization_revision.reason: First run rejected after consolidated JSON truncation during artifact handoff. Per-array metric shards bounded below 2 MiB replace the consolidated file. No model, data, threshold or scenario changes.
serialization_revision.exposure: Aggregate status counts from first run were visible before this format-only revision; no new untouched-evaluation claim.
